label: Max slippage
purpose: Cap price impact on fills.
whenToChange: Increase for volatile/illiquid markets; decrease in tight markets.
risks: Too low rejects trades; too high causes bad fills.
rationale: Balance fill probability vs adverse selection.

label: Max notional per trade (USD)
purpose: Limit exposure per fill.
whenToChange: Increase with strong liquidity and confidence; decrease when testing.
risks: Too high concentrates risk; too low increases missed opportunities.

label: Minimum target profit
purpose: Discard routes below this net profit.
whenToChange: Increase if slippage is high; decrease if fills are rare.
risks: Too high misses profitable routes; too low captures noise.

label: Grid step percent
purpose: Price spacing between grid levels.
whenToChange: Increase in high volatility; decrease in tight ranges.
risks: Too small overtrades; too large misses trades.

label: Cooldown between trades (ms)
purpose: Avoid spamming orders in bursts.
whenToChange: Increase if markets are choppy; decrease if opportunities are fleeting.
risks: Too short causes churn; too long misses windows.

label: Max route hops
purpose: Cap path complexity to control execution risk.
whenToChange: Increase if liquidity fragmented; decrease to reduce failure surface.
risks: More hops increase slippage + failure probability.

label: Maximum raw profit (bps)
purpose: Ceiling to discard absurd/arbitrary mispriced paths before netting.
whenToChange: Rarely change; lower during testing to suppress outliers.
risks: Too low may hide valid outsized quotes.

label: Minimum notional (USD)
purpose: Discard routes that move too little value.
whenToChange: Increase to reduce noise; decrease for testing.
risks: Too high may miss scalable routes.

label: Quote size (USD)
purpose: Size used to evaluate cycle profitability.

label: Max detector idle (ms)
purpose: Upper bound on time between detection cycles.
whenToChange: Increase on slow machines; decrease for faster reaction.
risks: Too low increases CPU; too high delays opportunities.

label: Enable near-miss detection
purpose: Emit candidates just below threshold for analysis.
risks: Too many near-misses can add noise to logs.

label: Near-miss epsilon
purpose: Slack in log-space to consider near-threshold candidates.

label: Emit sub-threshold cycles
purpose: Log/emit cycles below min profit for inspection.

label: Top-N sub-threshold to log
purpose: Limit noisy diagnostics to N best near-misses.

label: Log near-miss failures
purpose: Emit diagnostics when no near-miss found.

label: Est. priority fee per hop (lamports)
purpose: Rough per-hop fee estimate used when netting profit.

label: Enable filtered detection
purpose: Use incremental/filtered detection between periodic full runs.

label: Filtered node ratio
purpose: Fraction of nodes expanded during filtered detection.

label: Filtered expand hops
purpose: Optional hop expansion depth when filtered.

label: Periodic full detection (ms)
purpose: Interval for full detection pass; 0 disables.

label: Drop stable↔stable hops
purpose: Prune cycles containing stable-to-stable edges (e.g., USDC↔USDT).

label: Max SOL↔stable hops
purpose: Limit SOL<->stable transitions per cycle.

label: Stable mints (CSV)
purpose: Override set of stablecoin mint addresses used by pruning.
